sentences.text: Researchers conducted a cohort study involving 172 healthy human adults to examine brain activity patterns.

The analysis revealed that the fluctuation of brain network connections over time differed significantly between resting states and a language task, with some networks showing clear changes in connection strength while others remained stable.
The authors concluded that tracking these changing connection patterns may help separate brain networks specific to language from those involved in general cognition.
